تقتبلين (form VIII)
# تَقْتَبِلِينَ (taqtabilīna) /taq.ta.bi.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
# تُقْتَبَلِينَ (tuqtabalīna) /tuq.ta.ba.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
